schemes.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate income/ long-term capital appreciation by investing in equity, equity derivatives, fixed income instruments. The allocation between equity instruments and fixed income will be managed dynamically so as to provide investors with long term capital appreciation while managing downside risk. However, there is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved and the Scheme does not assure or guarantee any returns.
